Name: Hakan NPC - Furry Wolfman
Author: hakydaky
Description:
[center][url=https://bsky.app/profile/wolfescratch.bsky.social]﻿[/url]﻿Hakan is one of my OCs that I decided to self indulgently add into Stardew Valley. He starts off kind of indifferent to the player but quickly becomes familiar enough to tease you. He's also kind of bad at showing affection, but will try none the less.[/center][center]﻿[b]Hakan shows up once the boulder blocking the railroad is removed! This happens on the third day of Summer.[/b][/center][b]

[/b][b]Features:
[/b]
[list]
[*]A handsome rugged wolfman adventurer
[*]New areas, the foothills, and Hakan's cabin. (Which I might expand on later?)
[*]Marriageable with spouse room and patio
[*]Winter outfits! Ginger island outfit! 
[*]Movie tastes, Festival placements.
[*]Fanservice ;)
[*]~700 unique dialogue lines.
[*]8 Events
[*]SVE integration
[/list][b]
Requirements:
[/b][b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
﻿[/list][/b][b]﻿I also recommend you play this mod with [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083][b]Anthro Characters Continued[/b][/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22271]Furry Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] because animal people yeah. Also, I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] for the full experience! Additionally, if you'd like, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19305]Schedule Viewer[/url] to view his schedule.

[b]Installation﻿:
[/b]- Install SMAPI, and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the file
- Place in the Stardew Valley mods folder.

[b]Compatibility:
[/b]- Should be compatible with most mods, but there might be issues with any mods that edits the map west of the bathhouse (that's where you enter the foothills).
- If there's any weird interactions with other mods report them and I might fix it.

[b]Credits:[/b]
- [url=https://bsky.app/profile/wolfescratch.bsky.social]WolfeScratch[/url] for helping me with dialogue
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/336298]RydelTheOtter[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2417747]sion9000[/url], and [url=https://ko-fi.com/gaveliere]Gavel[/url] for making the furry conversion mod.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] for making SVE.
-﻿ All the awesome people on the SDV discord who helped me!! 

[b]Addons[/b]: 
-  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28223?tab=description]Nyapu Style Portrait for Hakan[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Coludy12?gameId=1303]Coludy12[/url]

[b]Translations: 
[/b]- If you would like to contribute a translation for the mod, you can submit them on [url=https://github.com/hakydaki/Haki_Stardew_NPC]github[/url] or upload them to nexus.

[b]This is my first mod so bugs are bound to show up. I'll try to fix them later on as they are reported.

[u]PLEASE TELL ME IF YOU ARE USING SVE WHEN REPORTING BUGS![/u][/b]

[b]Events:[/b]
[spoiler][b]2 Hearts[/b] - Fix the bridge for the tide pools, then visit the beach between 2 and 6 pm during the summer.
[b]4 Hearts[/b] - Visit the town between 8 pm and 12 am on a rainy day.
[b]6 Hearts[/b] - Go to the woods between 9 am and 6 pm during any season except winter.
[b]8 Hearts[/b] - If playing with SVE, go to Blue Moon Vineyard. Otherwise, go to the beach. Visit one of these locations between 12pm and 6pm.
[b]9 Hearts[/b] -  Pierre's 6 heart cutscene should be viewed first. Then, visit Pierre's store between 9 am and 6 pm.
[b]10 Hearts[/b] - Visit the railroad during the winter between the times of 6pm and 12am.[/spoiler]
